edges.reason: deployer is assigned from msg.sender in the constructor, granting a privileged role to the caller.
onlyDeployer requires msg.sender == deployer before the full balance transfer.
mintDolphin mints tokens to msg.sender and reads the caller payment.
setApprovalForAll writes operator approvals keyed by msg.sender.
msg.sender is hashed into the pseudo-random index computation.
block.timestamp is part of the randomness source, allowing miner/validator influence over token ids.
randomIndex reads and writes the indices swap-and-pop array.
randomIndex increments the nonce after deriving the index.
the random index is derived from a predictable hash of nonce, sender, difficulty and timestamp.
the weak randomness hash consumes block.timestamp as one of its inputs.
getPrice returns the price state variable.
RemainingtoMint subtracts numTokens from TOKEN_LIMIT.
totalSupply returns numTokens.
_mint increments numTokens after each mint.
mintDolphin checks numTokens.add(quantity) against the supply cap.
mintDolphin enforces the TOKEN_LIMIT supply cap.
mintDolphin enforces the MAX_PURCHASE per-transaction limit.
mintDolphin requires msg.value >= price.mul(quantity).
mintDolphin pays pricehalf.mul(quantity) to each beneficiary.
reentrancyGuard toggles reentrancyLock around the external transfers during minting.
devMint is restricted by the onlyDeployer modifier using the deployer variable.
approve writes the idToApproval mapping.
setApprovalForAll writes ownerToOperators.
isApprovedForAll reads ownerToOperators.
_transfer reads and rewrites idToOwner via add/remove helpers.
_addNFToken assigns idToOwner for the token.
_addNFToken pushes the token id into ownerToIds.
_addNFToken records the token index in idToOwnerIndex.
_removeNFToken deletes the idToOwner entry.
_removeNFToken mutates the ownerToIds list.
_removeNFToken updates idToOwnerIndex during swap-and-pop.
_getOwnerNFTCount reads the ownerToIds array length.
_clearApproval deletes the idToApproval entry.
supportsInterface reads the supportedInterfaces mapping.
constructor registers ERC165/721 interface support flags.
isContract obtains the code size via inline assembly extcodesize.
safeTransferFrom with data delegates to _safeTransferFrom.
safeTransferFrom without data delegates to _safeTransferFrom.
transferFrom performs the internal _transfer.
_safeTransferFrom performs the internal _transfer before the callback.
_safeTransferFrom checks whether the receiver is a contract.
_transfer clears the token approval first.
_transfer removes the token from the sender.
_transfer adds the token to the receiver.
_mint obtains the next token id from randomIndex.
_mint registers the new token to the recipient.
mintDolphin loops calling _mint for each quantity.
mintDolphin executes an external value transfer to beneficiary1 before minting completes.
mintDolphin executes a second external value transfer to beneficiary2 before minting completes.
withdraw transfers the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
devMint loops calling _mint for each quantity.
tokenURI calls toString to build the metadata path.
_safeTransferFrom calls onERC721Received on the receiver contract, exposing a reentrant hook.
the receiver callback can re-enter safe transfer or mint logic before state finalization.
quantity controls the mint loop count and the required payment in mintDolphin.
quantity controls the devMint loop iteration count.
recipient is the mint target passed into _mint by devMint.
_data is forwarded verbatim into the receiver callback.
local index selects the indices array slot to rewrite.
local value holds the resulting token id before the increment.
balance is the amount swept out by the msg.sender.transfer call.
local id is the token identifier returned and stored by _mint.
retval is the receiver callback return checked after the external call.
_operator is granted blanket approval over msg.sender assets.

normalization_plan.reason: mintDolphin.quantity is an argument consumed only by the mintDolphin function.
devMint.quantity is an argument consumed only by the devMint function.
devMint.recipient is an argument consumed only by the devMint function.
_safeTransferFrom._data is a parameter of _safeTransferFrom forwarded to the receiver callback.
randomIndex.index is a local variable local to the randomIndex function.
randomIndex.value is a local variable local to the randomIndex function.
withdraw.balance directly feeds the unsafe msg.sender.transfer sweep.
_mint.id is a local variable returned and used only by _mint.
_safeTransferFrom.retval is a local variable checked inside _safeTransferFrom after the callback.
setApprovalForAll._operator is a parameter consumed only by setApprovalForAll.
